tests.title: Three tall units, right wall
tests.prompt: add a group of three tall units to the wall on the right

tests.title: Four cabinets, back wall
tests.prompt: add a group of 4 cabinets to the wall in the back

tests.title: Kitchen in the back right corner
tests.prompt: plan a kitchen in the back right corner of the room

tests.title: Oven, range hood, sink, fridge in the corner
tests.prompt: plan a kitchen with an oven, a range hood, a sink and a fridge in the back right corner of the room

tests.title: Oven, fridge, sink in the corner
tests.prompt: create a kitchen with an oven, a fridge and a sink in the back right corner of the room

tests.title: Image: kitchen on the left-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one in the image on the left-hand wall of the room

tests.title: Image: kitchen in the back right corner
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one shown in the image, in the back right corner of the room

tests.title: Image: planning on the right-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a planning as to the one shown in the picture on the right-hand wall of the room.

tests.title: Image only, no text
tests.expect: the model decides what to plan; the chat sends the image with its default text "Identify the furniture in the image (for example a kitchen, wardrobe, media unit, lowboard, sideboard, cabinet or utility room) and create a planning as close to it as possible."

tests.title: Image only, no text: tall units
tests.expect: the model identifies the furniture as tall units (a wardrobe or cabinet), not a kitchen, and plans it as close to the image as possible: three tall units side by side; no sink, hob, oven, worktop or base units

tests.title: Full kitchen, walnut, dark marble, around the corner
tests.prompt: create a kitchen with an oven, hob, cooker hood, fridge, sink and cabinet with drawers, as well as wall cabinets in the back right corner of the room. Arrange the kitchen around the corner. The front of the kitchen should be made of walnut and the worktop should be made of dark marble
tests.expect: appliances: oven, hob, cooker hood, fridge, sink; storage: cabinet with drawers, wall cabinets; placement: back right corner, around the corner; materials: walnut front, dark marble worktop

tests.title: Add one unit
tests.prompt: add a cabinet with drawers to the right of the kitchen
tests.expect: merge-article-into-group: a drawer cabinet at the front end of the row

tests.title: Replace a unit
tests.prompt: replace the middle unit with a cabinet with drawers
tests.expect: exchange-root-module: the middle unit becomes a drawer cabinet, the row stays

tests.title: Remove a unit
tests.expect: delete-root-module: the kitchen splits into two groups that keep their places

tests.title: Change one unit
tests.prompt: make the first unit 900 mm wide
tests.expect: change-module-attribute: mod_Width 900 on the first unit

tests.title: Change the whole kitchen
tests.prompt: make the fronts of the whole kitchen white
tests.expect: change-group-attribute: a white mod_FrontColor on every unit

tests.title: Join groups
tests.prompt: join the two groups on the right wall
tests.expect: merge-groups: one group with both units

tests.title: Delete a group
tests.expect: delete-group: the plan has no groups

tests.title: Undo the last change
tests.expect: undo: one group of three tall units again

tests.title: Redo the undone change
tests.expect: redo: the middle unit removed again, two groups

tests.title: Undo a wrong command
tests.prompt: that was the wrong unit - remove the last unit, not the middle one
tests.expect: undo, then delete-root-module on the last unit: one group of the first two units
